function: Excluded (system): D2D links are single-antenna with scalar channel gains h_{u,u'} and a power-only decision p_u, and no RIS (pp. 7, 11).
notes: System exclusion. The only modelled link is the D2D link: p. 7 gives a scalar SINR with one transmit power p_u per UD and channel gains |h_{u,u'}|^2; p. 11: "ha and hb indicate the heights of the antennas transmitter and receiver" (one antenna per end), and Table II lists a 2.5 dBi UD antenna gain. No antenna array, beamforming or RIS is in the system model (RIS and massive MIMO appear only in related work, p. 3). The learned element is a GNN (MPNN, MPRNN) that outputs the D2D transmit power for FL model diffusion (p. 9, Eq. 27); the global OAC aggregation at the BS is stated but not designed (p. 4). Treated as area 7 (FL with OAC), so check 6 applies. If the reviewer judges that the GNN solves D2D power control rather than the over-the-air aggregation itself, the code would be function instead; the decision stays exclude. The WMMSE baseline text mentions a beamforming vector (p. 12), but no multi-antenna model is defined.
